_comment.client_secrets_file: Path to Google OAuth 2.0 client secrets JSON (YouTube Data API v3 credentials).
_comment.token_file: Path to stored OAuth token file (created automatically on first auth).
_comment.youtube_upload_scope: OAuth scope(s) requested for YouTube upload access.
_comment.youtube_readonly_scope: OAuth scope(s) for read-only YouTube access (needed to list channels). Combined with upload scope for OAuth flow.
_comment.video_category: YouTube category ID for uploaded videos (15 = Pets & Animals; see catogory.txt for full list).
_comment.video_directory: Directory containing MP4 video files to upload.
_comment.csv_file: CSV file with video metadata (consumed via csv.DictReader). Rows with is_processed=1 are skipped on re-runs; the script updates is_processed and video_id after each successful upload.
_comment.set_size: Number of videos to upload per batch (one batch per day).
_comment.schedule_timings: List of [hour, minute] UTC times for each video within a batch, applied in order.
_comment.oauth_port: Local server port for OAuth callback (0 = random available port). Must match a redirect URI registered in Google Cloud Console (e.g. http://localhost:8080).
_comment.auth_method: OAuth flow method: 'local_server' (opens browser, needs redirect URI registered) or 'console' (prints URL, no redirect URI needed).
_comment.list_channels: If true, lists all channels the authenticated user owns/manages and exits. Use --list-channels CLI flag to see available channels when the Google account has multiple YouTube channels.
